[[File:ZX3DroidTrooper-NEGTD.png|thumb|Briletto AAP-IV blaster box wielded by a Z-X3 Experimental droid trooper.]]
The '''AAP-IV Blaster Box''' was a harness-mounted blaster weapon device produced by the [[Briletto Company]] and, unlike the similar [[Reciprocating quad blaster cannon/Legends|reciprocating quad blaster cannon]], designed specifically to be used by [[Droid|droids]]. Each AAP-IV consisted of a main barrel attached to a harness typically worn on a droid's chest but could be strapped to many shapes and sizes of droid. It was used to relatively cheaply weaponize droids that lacked in-built weapon systems or were not created for combat. It's most notable appearance was when a rogue [[Z-X3 experimental droid trooper|Z-X3 Experimental Droid Trooper]] attempted to usurp control of [[Droid World]].<ref name="AAP-IV">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
